text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, while on a stroll along the
river, I notice a certain
runner out of the
corner of my eye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Ah, good morning!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you bet! How could I not be when
it's so nice outside?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could do laps forever in
this
weather. Anyway, I'll let you
get back to
your walk! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our short exchange now over, Mejiro Ryan
takes off. Her jog seems to
be more for fun than sport,
but her form is still consistent.
It's honestly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that thought is quickly replaced by
another, more immediate
concern...
Shouldn't she be headed to school?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. I wanted to try out that new
running routine! Better do
one... no, five
more laps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Ah, it's you again... What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Late? For wha—aaah! School! I gotta
go, and quick!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, thanks for the heads-up! It was so
nice this morning, I totally
zoned out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, gotta run! Thanks again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan dashes off towards the school,
once again displaying her
flawless running
form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That same day, after classes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're the person from this morning!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that badge... Ah, that's how you
knew I was running late! You're
a trainer
here, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks again for the save! And don't
worry, I made it to school in
time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to pay you back somehow, but
how... Ah, I know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, could you come with me for a second?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right,
we're finally here! As thanks for
helping me this morning...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We're gonna work out together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You bet! As far as thanks go, this is
probably the best I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've always loved moving my body, you
see. In fact, exercise might be
the only
thing I'm good at.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But hey, that just makes me the best kind
of coach—the kind that shows you how fun
workouts can be! I'll even come up with
the
perfect routine for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Suddenly being asked to work out
must be kinda strange, right?
Sorry, I can
come up with something else if you like...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My hesitation clearly has Mejiro Ryan
feeling down. I decide to step
up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! Awesome! In that case,
let's get
changed and pump some
iron!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew! How's that, Trainer?! Feelin' the
burn yet?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't sweat it if you're having
trouble
keeping up! We've just
been waking up
your muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right, time for the real workout! Well hydrated?! Great! Let's get SWOLE!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's it! One more rep! One more! Hm?
Can't keep going? Okay, just
one more to
finish out the set and...
Yeah! You did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Great job! Do you feel that,
Trainer? I bet
your heart, your
pectorals—your whole
body's screaming out in gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! Then let's scream back and show
your body what it's made of!
On to the
second round!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
Trainer... This is it! The final stretch!
Come on! Count out the
reps with me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Threeee! Woohoo! You did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Exhaustion consumes me... but it's
accompanied by a strong feeling of

accomplishment and pride! After all, that
was one intense workout!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, today's workout was made with you
in mind. I'd say I usually do...
about four
times more in total.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But any exercise is good exercise as
far as
your muscles are
concerned! Keep it up,
and you'll see results in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats seeing your time go down,
even by a single second. And when your
hard work shows on the track... Man,
that's something
entirely different!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That moment when you're the fastest on
the track... when you cross
that finish line
before anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Feeling your muscles burn and that heat
spread throughout your
body... No better
experience than that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You bet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hope that's not... too disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's reaction to my question is a bit
perplexing, but before I can
continue,
another Umamusume approaches her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Where are yo—ah, there you are!
Figures you'd be in the gym!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! What's up?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are coming up, remember? I
figured you'd be training for
that, so let's
run together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! That'd be amazing! Wanna
get started right now?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd say yes! ♪ I'll go get
changed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Guess I better get going too. Great work
today—I mean it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: See ya 'round!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from that conversation, Mejiro
Ryan's running in the tryouts...
Which
means I'll be able to see how she runs at
her best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With something to look forward to, I pack
up and leave the gym with
a spring in my
step. Or... I would if I wasn't so sore.
